name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's journey into motorsport was unconventional, sparked by a childhood fascination with the precision engineering of Korean automobiles. He began his career as a technician, quickly earning a reputation for meticulousness and an uncanny ability to diagnose complex mechanical issues. His talent for translating technical data into actionable insights led him to a role coordinating test drivers, where he excels at bridging the gap between engineers and drivers. 

At Brad Jones Racing, Park is known for his pragmatic approach to problem-solving and his dedication to optimizing vehicle performance through rigorous testing and analysis. While he values teamwork, his ability to independently dissect data and formulate strategies is what sets him apart. He prioritizes quantifiable results and measurable improvements, making him an invaluable asset in the pursuit of competitive advantage. Park's driving force is ensuring the team's cars are performing at their absolute peak.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Park is a man of average height with a wiry build, often seen wearing practical, functional clothing.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and calculations.
Insists on using a specific brand of Korean coffee during testing sessions.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
